paper_records.saved_takeaway: Sequential frozen heterogeneous-architecture GNN teacher KD, adaptive node temperature and TRAIN-error reweighting; final student alone predicts. Graph conditions GNN outputs, while the extra error/temperature rules do not directly transport errors along topology. No shared trainable BE body or typed graph result.
paper_records.operation: Weighted supervised CE plus all-node soft-label cross-entropy with learned bounded teacher-based temperatures. Teacher is fixed at each distillation step; newly initialized students become later teachers.

evaluated_scope.endpoint: Classification accuracy; 10 rounds stated in main, top5-of10 graph rounds disclosed in appendix
evaluated_scope.pooling: Final student; separately supervised comparison ensemble averages raw logits

limits: Numeric random split ratios, exact checkpoint selector and temperature MLP dimensions unresolved by inspected recipe
Single-teacher main table chooses better of two teachers; selection criterion not stated
Graph task top5-of10 conflicts with unrestricted ten-round summary
Printed Eq3 class-summed soft-label CE gradient is zero and is not a vector gradient
Printed entropy Eq4 uses t termed raw logits; normalization needs source reconciliation
Printed Eq7 uses one-hot y in SAMME.R-style formula; signed multiclass coding cannot be assumed
paper_records.relationship_to_GNNM_and_extension: Direct error-guided architecture-transfer prior. A simultaneous graph-smoothed BE allocation is a different complete update, but cannot inherit BGNN efficacy or novelty.
paper_records.disposition: Attribute, preserve formula/reporting caveats, no direct native port

paper_records.saved_takeaway: TFE-GNN learns low-pass and high-pass power-stream coefficients, then sums/concatenates streams before one MLP CE head. Filter ensemble is not independently trained predictive members, error-based specialization or shared BE. Generalized high-pass normalization and dataset-specific group optimizer recipes matter.
paper_records.operation: Learned weighted sum of graph operator powers in two streams, learned stream scales, summation or concatenation, decoupled MLP prediction and supervised CE. Large graph variant transforms/dimension-reduces before propagation.

evaluated_scope.endpoint: Classification accuracy; generalization gap plots; Cora100-epoch timing only
evaluated_scope.pooling: Filter stream combination before one prediction; no predictive-member pool

limits: Some comparison results copied, some reproduced; exact all-model paired split equality not independently verified
Appendix says parameter and seed tuning may be needed for reproduction
Approximate TRAIN/dataset homophily used for filter-order choice may be wrong
Descriptive train/validation gap and approximation capacity do not prove predictive generalization
No numeric results adopted or reproduced
paper_records.relationship_to_GNNM_and_extension: Close heterophily filter-combination backbone prior; cannot support persistent predictive-member error specialization by the name ensemble alone.
paper_records.disposition: Attribute graph filter combination; no new error-training mechanism derived from its theorems or tables
